title: SCS unit schema (source format)
description: Validates files under data/schemas/ — the hand-authored source format. This is NOT the shape of data/dist/ (the build-generated, inheritance-flattened output nobody edits by hand, so it doesn't need editor IntelliSense or validation).

oneOf.description: Plain text value | e.g., key: "x"
Single float number | e.g., key: x or HEX ieee754: &3f800000
Vector of 2 floats | e.g., key: (x, y)
Vector of 3 floats | e.g., key: (x, y, z)
Vector of 4 floats | e.g., key: (x, y, z, w)
Placement transform | e.g., key: (x, y, z)(w; x, y, z)
Fixed-point number | e.g., key: x
Vector of 2 fixed-point numbers | e.g., key: (x, y)
Vector of 3 fixed-point numbers | e.g., key: (x, y, z)
Vector of 4 fixed-point numbers | e.g., key: (x, y, z, w)
Vector of 2 integers | e.g., key: (x, y)
Quaternion rotation | e.g., key: (w, x, y, z)
Signed 16-bit integer | e.g., key: x
Signed 32-bit integer | e.g., key: x
Signed 64-bit integer | e.g., key: x
Unsigned 16-bit integer | e.g., key: x
Unsigned 32-bit integer | e.g., key: x
Unsigned 64-bit integer | e.g., key: x
Boolean flag | e.g., true|false
String of max length 12, only lowercase alphanumeric and underscore: [a-z0-9_]
Refers to a unit defined within the same SiiNunit | e.g., ".trailer.tchassis"
Refers to a named unit defined elsewhere | e.g., "cabin_a.brand.model.cabin"

Typically used to bind animations to animated models (e.g. "path/to/file.pma") — same syntax as 'string'. The wiki's own example is specifically .pma; don't assume it covers other file types (.pmd, .pmc, etc.) unless a specific class's docs say so.

typeList.description: One or more allowed types. null means "not applicable" (see the sibling field's own description for exactly when that is).

versionNote.description: Free-text note on when this was added/removed/changed, exactly as the wiki phrases it (e.g. "Added in 1.38.", "Removed in 1.44 (ETS2 only)."). null when there's nothing noteworthy. Deliberately NOT split into separate addedIn/removedIn fields: the extension never knows what game version the user has installed, so this is display-only information, never something compared programmatically — and the wiki itself isn't consistent enough (sometimes one version, sometimes different per game, sometimes a whole sentence) to force into stricter structure.

classNameList.description: One or more class_name values (e.g. for pointsTo). null when not applicable.

meta.description: Metadata required for cache validation and file context. Must always be present and follow this exact structure.

version.description: Semver version of this schema FILE (not of the game). Must be "0.1.0" on a new file. Bumped automatically by scripts/update.mjs based on conventional-commit messages touching this file — don't edit by hand.

documentationStatus.description: "wip" mirrors the same warning the SCS wiki itself shows on several unit-type pages ("has yet to be reviewed by SCS staff") — use it while you're still filling this file in or unsure about some of it.

scope.description: The class_name this file documents. Should match the file name (without .json).

description.description: What this class_name is, in a sentence or two. Shown in completion/hover for the class_name itself.

superclass.description: The DIRECT parent class_name this one inherits attributes from — not the whole ancestor chain (scripts/build.mjs resolves that recursively). Use the literal value "unit" when there's no real documented parent — that's the engine's own generic root type, confirmed via package_version_info's "Raw Unit Definition" section, not a real class to look up.

allowsSiiNunitRoot.description: false for classes documented as needing to be @include-d rather than used as a file's SiiNunit root (e.g. cargo_data, trailer say "must not use the SiiNunit magic mark"). true for everything else.

key.description: This class's OWN attributes only — never copy in attributes inherited from superclass; scripts/build.mjs merges those in automatically when generating data/dist/.

type.description: Allowed type(s) for the SCALAR form (key: value). null if this attribute ONLY ever exists as a dynamic array (e.g. str_params — see the SCS docs' trigger_action page).

isArray.description: true if this attribute supports EITHER array form (key[]: value repeated, or key: N followed by key[0]..key[N-1]). false if it's only ever a bare key: value.

arrayElementType.description: Allowed type(s) for each array element. Required (non-null) whenever isArray is true; must be null when isArray is false.

required.description: Whether the SCS docs mark this attribute as required (shown as bold text, or as a dedicated Required/Optional column — the wiki uses both conventions inconsistently across pages).

values.description: Valid literal values for a token-typed attribute, when the docs enumerate them (e.g. cargo_model_match's loading_method). null when not documented or not applicable.

pointsTo.description: For owner_ptr/link_ptr attributes: which class_name(s) the pointed-to unit is expected to be (e.g. trailer.accessories accepts several vehicle_*_accessory classes). null when not documented or not a pointer type.

expectedExtensions.description: Which file extension(s) this attribute's value is expected to have, without the leading dot (e.g. ["pmd"], ["pmc"]) — for ANY attribute whose value is a file path, not just resource_tie ones (most such attributes are actually typed as plain 'string' per the wiki, not resource_tie — see resource_tie's own description above). null when not documented, not a file path, or the path format doesn't cleanly reduce to one expected extension (e.g. a sound attribute that can be either a .soundref file OR a direct "bank#event" string).

supportsLocalization.description: true if the docs note this string-ish value supports the @@localization@@ template syntax (e.g. cargo_data's name).

internalOnly.description: true if the docs say this should not be set manually in a definition (engine/save-game managed — several trailer attributes are like this).

notes.description: Anything else worth keeping that doesn't fit the fields above. Empty string when there's nothing to add.

dynamicAttributeGroups.description: For families of attributes the docs describe collectively rather than name individually (e.g. accessory_interior_data's "nearly 70 interior animation attributes"). Optional — omit or leave empty ([]) for classes without this.

pattern.description: Short label for the group, e.g. "interior animation attributes".

description.description: What the group is, roughly how many attributes, and where to find the real names if documented elsewhere.

notes.description: Anything else — e.g. a link to a page that lists the actual attribute names.
